scene_summary: A grainy black-and-white exposure plate concentrates a bleached, hollow-centered silhouette on the left and a darker, visibly face-like silhouette at lower right. A broad pale diagonal connects the lower masses. Small charcoal cuts, interrupted horizontal trails, and an enclosed dark pinhole provide distinct interaction anchors. The upper-right field remains largely empty. Seven planned anchors have visible support; the proposed doubled-contour gap and diagonal white nick are not sufficiently distinct to map confidently.

detected_objects.label: Bleached crown
detected_objects.visual_evidence: An irregular white arch rises to a pointed upper crest and descends in ghosted side traces around a tall charcoal hollow. The polygon follows the pale arch rather than filling its dark center.

detected_objects.label: Frayed crossing
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A luminous oblique swath enters from the left crop and spreads into the pale shoulder beside the dark hollow's lower end. Its upper edge has parallel dragged light traces and its lower edge dissolves into rough exposure grain. The visible crossing is supported, although it enters from the middle-left rather than the planned lower-left.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate remains expressionist and compositionally spare, with a broad dark upper-right field, two silhouette masses, and a connecting diagonal. Grain does not read as interface clutter. However, the lower-right face is fairly literal, and several interaction anchors are tiny cuts requiring careful hit-area treatment. Coverage is a visual estimate. No reliable separate doubled-contour gap or compact white nick on the diagonal was identified; neither was invented to complete the checklist.

mapping_note: Package assembly filled unmapped source pockets from planned artifact surfaces because plate inspection returned too few detected objects.
